# Welcome {.unnumbered}

Learn to analyze glycomics and glycoproteomics data with the
[Glycoverse](https://github.com/glycoverse) ecosystem. This book brings together
complete analyses and short, practical recipes with R code you can adapt to
your own experiments.

## How to read this book {.unnumbered}

Start with a case study for your data type. Each walks through data import,
preprocessing, statistical analysis, and the interpretation of glycan structures.
Then browse the catalog of "How to" to find the code recipe for specific tasks.

- Case Studies:
  - **[Glycomics](tutorials/glycomics.Rmd):** analyze glycan abundance data,
    assign candidate structures, and explore motifs and derived traits.
  - **[Glycoproteomics](tutorials/glycoproteomics.Rmd):** work through a complete
    glycopeptide analysis, from quantitative data to functional interpretation.
- **[How to](how-to/index.qmd):** look up a specific operation, such as
  subsetting an experiment, inspecting preprocessing history, or finding
  candidate glycan structures.

## Before you start {.unnumbered}

The examples assume familiarity with R and tidyverse data analysis. If these
are new to you, [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/) is a useful
companion. Being familiar with [SummarizedExperiment](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/SummarizedExperiment.html) is also helpful.
